idea-plugin.name: Phantom Workspaces
idea-plugin.description: All open projects in one window. On macOS, a project that opens while another is open joins the same window as a native window tab, so every project is one click (or Cmd+`) away. Each tab is still a whole project with its own tool windows and editors. Drag a tab out to give a project its own window again. Turn it off in Settings | Advanced Settings | Phantom Workspaces.
